fact: On 5 April 2023 in Freetown the ICT ministers of six ECOWAS states including Cabo Verde signed a memorandum of understanding with the ECOWAS Commission to develop the Amilcar Cabral submarine cable project, and Cabo Verde was named Chair of its Ministerial Steering Committee.
title: Six ECOWAS Member States sign a Memorandum of Understanding in the presence of the ECOWAS Commission for the development of the Amilcar Cabral submarine telecommunications cable project
publisher: Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS)
